readme:
SEO Skills for Claude Code, Cursor & AI Agents

30 open-source SKILL.md workflows that ship real SEO outputs instead of 50-page audit PDFs nobody reads.
Run daily repo SEO on autopilot, pull live Ahrefs & DataForSEO SERP gaps, build a First-Hand Proof KB, ship honest /vs/ pages, de-slop MDX for AI search, track ChatGPT & Perplexity citations (GEO), and build DR 30–60+ backlinks.

Browse Web Catalog · Quick Install · All 30 Skills · Workflows · MCP Servers · Sponsors · FAQ

![SEO Skills for Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenAI Codex: installable SKILL.md workflows that turn AI coding agents into Google #1 rankings](assets/seo-skills-hero.jpg) --- ## Install Install every skill in one command using the [`skills`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/skills) CLI, or install individual skills on demand: ```bash # Install all 30 SEO, GEO, Ahrefs/DataForSEO research, proof KB, link building & copywriting skills npx skills add Illyism/seo-skills # Install a single skill (for example, daily autonomous repo SEO) npx skills add Illyism/seo-skills --skill seo-autopilot # List every available skill in this repository npx skills add Illyism/seo-skills --list ``` ### Works Across Every Coding Agent & AI Chat App Each skill is a self-contained folder with a plain Markdown `SKILL.md` following the open [Agent Skills specification](https://agentskills.io). Your agent loads only the short `name` and `description` at startup and opens the full instructions only when your prompt matches, keeping your context window fast and clean. | Environment | Where `SKILL.md` lives | How to install | | --- | --- | --- | | **Claude Code** | `.claude/skills/` or `~/.claude/skills/` | `npx skills add Illyism/seo-skills -a claude-code` | | **Cursor** | `.cursor/skills/` or `.agents/skills/` | `npx skills add Illyism/seo-skills -a cursor` | | **OpenAI Codex / OpenCode** | `.agents/skills/` | `npx skills add Illyism/seo-skills` | | **Windsurf / Cline / Roo Code** | `.agents/skills/` | `npx skills add Illyism/seo-skills` | | **ChatGPT, Claude.ai, Perplexity, Grok** | Paste or attach raw Markdown | Copy any skill directly at **[il.ly/skills](https://il.ly/skills)** | --- ## Why Output-First SEO Skills? Most "AI SEO prompt packs" generate giant checklists and health scores that sit in a folder forever. Every skill in `Illyism/seo-skills` is built to **end in a concrete, shippable output** inside your repository or marketing workflow: - **Codebase diffs you can merge:** Rewritten `` tags, `<h1>` alignment, MDX blog refreshes grounded in SERP gap analysis, `robots.txt` / bot-firewall middleware, verified `301` redirect maps, and new `/vs/` comparison routes. - **First-hand proof over AI commodity fluff:** `proof-kb`, `seo-blog-images`, and `unslop-seo` replace generic filler with atomic product benchmarks, real screenshots/SVG charts, and answer-engine HTML structure. - **Focused 30-day execution:** Instead of spreading effort across 200 low-intent keywords, `blitz-seo` concentrates technical fixes, internal links, SERP proof, and authority links onto **one money page** until it reaches Page 1. - **Google + AI Search (GEO / AEO) together:** Map the exact prompts buyers ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews, measure live citation share, and ship pages and third-party placements that close missing prompt clusters. ![SEO Skills for AI Coding Agents: ship technical fixes, SERP-backed content refreshes, authority backlinks, and Google #1 rankings](assets/seo-skills-output-engine.webp) --- ## All 30 SEO Skills ### 1. **Viral X Outlier Finder (Free Chrome Extension):** Spot outlier posts and proven hooks across `390,000+` creators right inside X to distribute what you ship. | --- ## FAQ ### What are SEO skills for AI agents? An **SEO skill** is a portable folder containing a `SKILL.md` file with structured instructions, quality gates, and output templates that teach coding and research agents (Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, OpenCode, Windsurf) how to execute specialized search engine optimization workflows, covering technical audits, title tag rewrites, content refreshes, GEO citation tracking, and backlink planning. ### How do I use these SEO skills in Claude Code or Cursor? Run `npx skills add Illyism/seo-skills` in your project root (or globally). Claude Code and Cursor automatically index each skill's `name` and `description` and load the full `SKILL.md` whenever you ask for an SEO sprint, title audit, blog refresh, scraper block, or backlink plan. You can also invoke any skill explicitly by name (for example, *"Use `blog-refresher` on `content/blog/post.mdx`"*). ### Can I use these skills in ChatGPT, Claude.ai, or Perplexity without a terminal? Yes. Open **[il.ly/skills](https://il.ly/skills)**, click any skill, and hit **Copy prompt** (or open its raw `SKILL.md`) to paste directly into ChatGPT, Claude Desktop, Perplexity, or Grok. ### What is the difference between an SEO skill (`SKILL.md`) and an SEO MCP server? A **skill (`SKILL.md`)** teaches the agent *how to do the job* (the step-by-step methodology, SERP rules, formatting, and approval gates). An **MCP server** connects the agent to *live external data and actions* (Google Search Console metrics, live SERPs, AI citation scans, video transcripts, or backlink checkouts). Using both together gives your agent live search data plus senior-level SEO judgment. ### Which core SEO skills matter most for ranking in 2026? Modern search visibility across Google and AI answer engines comes down to five compounding disciplines covered in this repo: 1. **SERP Clustering, Competitor Research & Title Engineering** (`dataforseo-serp`, `ahrefs-research`, `seo-title-optimization`, `customer-journey`) 2. **First-Hand Proof Content, Visuals & De-Slopping** (`proof-kb`, `seo-blog-images`, `unslop-seo`, `blog-refresher`, `intro`, `scribiz`, `youtube-seo`) 3. **Technical Crawlability, Internal Routing & Migrations** (`seo-autopilot`, `seo-roast`, `internal-linking`, `domain-migration`, `block-ai-scrapers`) 4. **Authority Backlinks, Outreach & Syndication** (`directory-submissions`, `linkdr`, `honest-link-outreach`, `parasite-and-pr`, `awesome-tools`) 5. **Generative Engine Optimization (GEO / AEO) & Comparison Pages** (`aiseotracker`, `ai-seo-report`, `content-coverage`, `vs-and-alternatives`, `reddit-serp`) --- ## License MIT © [Ilias Ism](https://il.ly)

ahrefs-research *(diff competitor top-pages & filter real backlinks)* → vs-and-alternatives *(mine verified switching triggers, 1/5/25-seat pricing math & ship /vs/[competitor] + persona listicles)* → reddit-serp *(find unlocked Page-1 Reddit threads & draft practitioner replies)* → honest-link-outreach *(pitch varied, ask-first emails to ranking partner & editorial guides)*.

3. Push a Page-2 URL into the Google Top 3

seo-title-optimization *(fix CTR & SERP intent)* → blog-refresher *(close Top-10 entity & proof gaps)* → intro *(cut pogo-sticking in the first 80 words)* → linkdr *(point 2–4 DR 40+ contextual links at the refreshed URL)*.

customer-journey *(map buyer prompts across 5 stages)* → aiseotracker *(scan live AI answers)* → ai-seo-report *(spot third-party listicles & missing topics)* → content-coverage *(ship pages covering unowned prompt clusters)*.

understand-customers *(extract buyer language)* → blitz-copy *(write the landing page)* → directory-submissions & awesome-tools *(cascade across 15+ MCP registries & 50+ high-DR directories)* → blitz-seo *(run a focused 30-day sprint on your #1 commercial keyword)*.

Drop seo-autopilot on a daily schedule so your coding agent checks site health, verifies product claims against recent commits, refreshes decaying posts, and opens reviewable PRs. Pair it with diff-marketing every Friday to turn shipped code into distribution.

FAQ

What are SEO skills for AI agents?

An SEO skill is a portable folder containing a SKILL.md file with structured instructions, quality gates, and output templates that teach coding and research agents (Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, OpenCode, Windsurf) how to execute specialized search engine optimization workflows, covering technical audits, title tag rewrites, content refreshes, GEO citation tracking, and backlink planning.

How do I use these SEO skills in Claude Code or Cursor?

Run npx skills add Illyism/seo-skills in your project root (or globally). Claude Code and Cursor automatically index each skill's name and description and load the full SKILL.md whenever you ask for an SEO sprint, title audit, blog refresh, scraper block, or backlink plan. You can also invoke any skill explicitly by name (for example, *"Use blog-refresher on content/blog/post.mdx"*).

Can I use these skills in ChatGPT, Claude.ai, or Perplexity without a terminal?

Yes. Open il.ly/skills, click any skill, and hit Copy prompt (or open its raw SKILL.md) to paste directly into ChatGPT, Claude Desktop, Perplexity, or Grok.

What is the difference between an SEO skill (SKILL.md) and an SEO MCP server?

A skill (SKILL.md) teaches the agent *how to do the job* (the step-by-step methodology, SERP rules, formatting, and approval gates). An MCP server connects the agent to *live external data and actions* (Google Search Console metrics, live SERPs, AI citation scans, video transcripts, or backlink checkouts). Using both together gives your agent live search data plus senior-level SEO judgment.
